prerequisites: Original compatible EVE client x2 authenticated as different characters A/B
Disposable EveJS persistent GameStore world and full original Chat 01 overlay
No proprietary client binary modifications or invented RPC
EVEJS_COOP_SOCIAL_NATIVE_GUARDS=1 only after native source patch checked
Two corporations and actual fleet membership, optional alliance and bookmark sharing

stages.action: Two clients join one actual solar system; A writes local; B receives original chat stanza
verify: Native selected character IDs, one message per active client
Local membership list excludes logged-out session
Timestamp and sender match original server entry

stages.action: B jumps to a different solar system; A remains; test wormhole delayed local separately
verify: Old-room members no longer see B where not authorized
No stale session phantom in previous local room
Delayed local obeys original visibility rules

stages.action: A creates real fleet, invites B; both join fleet chat and A sends broadcast via Handle_SendBroadcast
verify: Both have actual native fleet membership and valid chat room
Broadcast UI accepts original protocol; no new unsupported method
Nonmember C cannot read fleet messages

stages.action: B leaves fleet; replay stale XMPP send or join with previous fleetid
verify: Authoritative fleetRuntime no longer maps B to old fleet
Old fleet messages and backlog blocked for B
No unauthorized message delivered to A

stages.action: Use two different real corporations; invite to shared alliance, then B leaves alliance
verify: Corporation messages remain private
Only genuine alliance member receives alliance messages
After membership change stale allianceid cannot send/read

stages.action: Authorized channel admin mutes B, then removes mute and changes room settings
verify: Mute/ban/password/invite-only native rules enforced
Permissions effective after reconnect
No hard-coded admin bypass or changed client opcode

stages.action: Inject native chatBacklog write/flush failure before XMPP fan-out
verify: No live success message from failed save
Original backlog cache not announced before durable write
Error and quarantine until operator reconciles native SQLite

stages.action: A sends B real EVEmail; B reads, labels and trashes; A verifies own sent mail
verify: Recipient B has mail record, sender A matches original character
Original native OnMailSent/GetBody/SyncMail shape
Read, trash, labels and unread counts agree after reconnect

stages.action: Inject native mail table flush failure
verify: No OnMailSent or NewMail notification on unknown commit
No blind retry while uncertain
Operator compares original mail and notification tables before unlock

stages.action: A adds/removes B personal contact, B adjusts corp/alliance contacts if authorized
verify: Correct native owner and permissions
Settings persist after cold restart
A/B contact lists remain isolated

stages.action: Trigger a legitimate fleet/mail/corporation notification and mark processed on B
verify: Original notification ID/type, receiver, sender, timestamps
Offline events discoverable after SyncMail/GetUnprocessed
No duplicate or wrong-character notification

stages.action: A creates native bookmark folder and shares where real corp access permits; B attempts view/edit
verify: Original bookmarkID and ownership
Corporation membership and folder ACL enforced
No bookmarks visible for unauthorized outsider

stages.action: A/B open native maps, inspect system Intel/history/sov data, save/retrieve overview preset link
verify: Map data grounded in actual server events, no fake intel
Overview preset stays per native owner/access
Client displays supported settings without unknown RPC

stages.action: Kill B client socket during mail, chat, broadcast and settings transition; restart server then reconnect both clients
verify: No ghost room, duplicate message or mailbox status
Fleet membership restored only where original native fleet persists
B sees same durable original mail/notification status as server
No new packets incompatible with original client

instruction: Cold restart and reconnect both independent clients between all consecutive steps. Inspect original SQLite/GameStore and session identities. Preserve world volumes; never zero or seed user inboxes. Unknown write outcomes require manual reconciliation, not compensating messages.
